# Continuity over an hour: twelve rounds about five minutes apart, each
# adding a line to the notes, across the realtime model's reconnects and
# new transcription sessions. The last question needs the whole hour.
@voice Sam Samantha
@voice Kim Karen
Sam [command]: Whiteboard, draw a box called project kickoff.
@pause 5
@repeat 12
Kim: Round {n} of the check in. Things are moving along.
Sam: Nothing new from me this round.
Kim [command]: Whiteboard, add a line to the notes: round {n} done.
@pause 285
@end
Sam [question]: Whiteboard, which round did we note first, and how many rounds are noted?
@pause 8
